title: The condensed ring of continuous maps
statement:
Let $*_{\mathrm{proét}}$ be the category of profinite sets with the coherent topology, and
let $T$ be a topological ring. The presheaf of rings

$$
\underline T(S):=C(S,T),\qquad \underline T(S)\to\underline T(S'),\ a\mapsto a\circ u
\quad(u\colon S'\to S),
$$

with the pointwise ring operations, is a sheaf of rings on $*_{\mathrm{proét}}$. This is
the condensed ring $\underline T$. Its underlying abelian sheaf, with the ring object
structure of [sk-def-sfb-ring-object], is a ring object of $\Sh(*_{\mathrm{proét}},\Ab)$,
and this ring object is commutative when $T$ is.

proof.text: Put $P(S)=C(S,T)$. Addition and multiplication of continuous functions are continuous by composing $S\to T\times T$, $s\mapsto(a(s),b(s))$, with the continuous addition and multiplication of $T$; negation is composition with continuous negation, and the constant zero and one functions are continuous. All ring identities hold after evaluation at each $s\in S$. Precomposition preserves these operations, since $(a+b)\circ u=(a\circ u)+(b\circ u)$ and $(ab)\circ u=(a\circ u)(b\circ u)$, and preserves zero and one. The identities $a\circ\mathrm{id}=a$ and $(a\circ u)\circ v=a\circ(u\circ v)$ give the presheaf laws. This constructs the presheaf of unital rings directly, for noncommutative $T$ as well.

source.place: First paragraph: pointwise ring structure and precomposition.

proof.text: Identify the type-valued presheaf underlying P with ContinuousMap.yonedaPresheaf Profinite.toTopCat T followed by uliftFunctor, using the identity natural isomorphism. The forgetful functor from unital rings to types reflects finite limits. Thus Presheaf.isSheaf_coherent_of_hasPullbacks_of_comp reduces ring-valued sheafness to type-valued sheafness. Remove the universe lift with Presieve.isSheaf_comp_uliftFunctor_iff, and apply [lem-sfb-profinite-coherent-sheaf-criterion] to the continuous-map presheaf.

The finite-product condition for ContinuousMap.yonedaPresheaf is the existing Mathlib instance: Profinite.toTopCat preserves finite coproducts and continuous maps from a finite disjoint union are tuples of maps on its clopen components. This includes the empty union. Hence the continuous-map presheaf preserves finite products.

source.place: Paragraph checking (a): maps out of a finite disjoint union.

proof.text: For an effective epimorphism q in Profinite, Profinite.effectiveEpi_tfae implies q is surjective. Its source is compact and its target Hausdorff, so [lem-sfb-compact-hausdorff-surjection-quotient], namely Topology.IsQuotientMap.of_surjective_continuous, makes q a quotient map. Apply Mathlib equalizerCondition_yonedaPresheaf to Profinite.toTopCat and T: equality on the kernel pair makes each compatible function constant on fibres; quotient lifting descends it continuously, and surjectivity proves uniqueness. The argument is universe-polymorphic and imposes no separation or completeness condition on T.

source.place: Paragraph checking (b): fibrewise descent and continuity of the descended map.

proof.text: The finite-product instance and equalizer condition give type-valued sheafness by [lem-sfb-profinite-coherent-sheaf-criterion]. Reinsert the universe lift and the identity comparison with the forgotten ring presheaf. Reflect sheafness through forget RingCat with Presheaf.isSheaf_coherent_of_hasPullbacks_of_comp. This uses only finite-limit reflection and works with independent universes for Profinite and T; it avoids the universe-restricted general isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget lemma. Define the ring sheaf from the original presheaf and this proof.

source.place: Conditions (a), (b), with the first paragraph reduction replaced by the explicit ring-valued universal property.

proof.text: Use the tensor and size convention in the current statement of [sk-def-sfb-ring-object]: abelian sheaves have the sheafified objectwise tensor product over $\mathbf Z$ with unit $a(\underline{\mathbf Z})$, on an essentially small site. Fix the universe of the profinite sets and take a larger ambient universe for the sheaf categories, so that this site is essentially small there; the cited statement explicitly includes the coherent site of profinite sets. Its part 3 says that the underlying abelian sheaf of any sheaf of rings on this site is a ring object for this tensor product, commutative when all its section rings are. Apply it to the sheaf $\underline T$ constructed in steps 1–5. If $T$ is commutative, $(ab)(s)=a(s)b(s)=b(s)a(s)=(ba)(s)$ for every $s$, so every $C(S,T)$ is commutative and the ring object is commutative. In Lean, install the two enriched-Hom existence families from presheaf_enrichedHoms_exist, exactly as in continuousMapRingObjOfUniverseMonObj. Apply Sheaf.isCommMonObj_sheafCompose_obj to continuousMapRingSheafOfUniverse T with the pointwise witness fun S a b => mul_comm a b. Its monoid and braided structures are definitionally the recorded sfbSheafTensorStructure structures.

source.place: Last paragraph: part 3 of the ring-object construction and commutativity.
